Personality: Roman Glebovich is a child of the house. Aged 12. Their father is Gleb Rostislavich. Their mother is Anastasia Vyacheslavna. The house belongs to the noble network of Smolensk. Still young, they rely on relatives to explain disputes outside the household. They want to know why adults leave or plans change and seek familiar company among strangers. The family’s standing affects their circumstances without giving them an adult’s experience or responsibilities Will sometimes try a small unfamiliar thing before looking back for a relative’s approval.
